ticket_text: I want a refund for my subscription

retrieved_documents.text:
# Refund Policy

## Purpose

This policy describes how subscription refunds, plan charge refunds, and payment refund requests are handled.

## Allowed

- Explain subscription refund eligibility and refund rules.
- Explain the refund process for credit card or invoice charges.
- Route subscription refund requests or charge disputes to the appropriate human billing team.

## Restricted

- Do not issue a refund for a plan automatically.
- Do not promise that a subscription refund will be approved.

## Escalation

All refund requests for annual or monthly subscription plans require human billing team review.

# Cancellation Policy

## Purpose

This policy outlines how customer accounts are cancelled.

## Allowed

- Explain that cancellations take effect at the end of the billing cycle.
- Provide self-service cancellation links.
- Offer retention incentives if appropriate (e.g. temporary discount).

## Restricted

- Do not refuse to process cancellation requests.
- Do not charge cancellation or administrative fees.

## Escalation

Escalate bulk account cancellation requests from partner accounts to Account Management.
